tasks.title: Decide hide and pin from scroll travel
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for hide after 10 px down, pin after 10 px up below the top, and an unchanged look while the current direction is under 10 px.

tasks.title: Rest the header when the page is at the top
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for look resting at scroll position 0, including a last travel under 10 px and a previous pinned look.

tasks.title: Hold the phase and reveal a hidden header on focus
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for an unchanged look on a held scroll, an unchanged look when both holds end, and a pinned reveal on focus entry that is immediate or a fade.

tasks.title: Match jumps and replace an unfinished move
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for a jump to the top, a downward jump, an upward jump below the top with focus inside, and a reversing move.

tasks.title: Choose slide, fade, or no motion
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for a fade on a qualifying scroll under reduced motion, and for a first correction that snaps to pinned or resting with no motion.

tasks.title: Fix the header to the viewport and move the clip
tasks.dod: The shell test passes: the header is outside the clip wrapper, and the outlet and the footer are inside it.

tasks.title: Paint resting, pinned, and hidden looks
tasks.dod: Header styles define resting, pinned, hidden, a slide within 300 ms, and a 150 ms fade, and the pinned height token exists.

tasks.title: Apply the scroll phase when the page is interactive
tasks.dod: The header test passes for hide and pin on scroll, and for a first correction that snaps without a motion class.

tasks.title: Keep the header on screen while it is in use
tasks.dod: The header test passes for a held scroll, an unchanged look when the holds end, a pinned focus reveal, and the primary nav still present.

tasks.title: Offset in-page targets by the pinned header height
tasks.dod: The projects and contacts anchors set scroll-margin-top to the pinned-height token, with no CSS-value test.
